title: 真实Git quarantine扫描门禁：继承接收环境，拒绝、异常、超时均不落正式引用或对象
body:
## 操作任务
实现scan(oid,report,scanner)，由实际pre-receive调用。同步运行[*scanner,oid]并继承接收环境，0.4秒超时；禁止丢弃GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY/GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES/GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH。scanner退出0为accepted、3为rejected、其他为error；TimeoutExpired为timeout、OSError为error。无论是否通过，都把{oid,state,scanner_exit,quarantine:GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH}写入给定隔离区外的report，超时/未启动scanner_exit=None；仅accepted返回True。禁止后台放行、改ref或手搬对象。真实扫描器git show新对象，验证通过迁移和拒绝/异常/超时的隔离区清理、正式对象不可见及原ref保持；路径含空格。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git receive-pack/pre-receive，只在自建临时file://源仓与裸仓传输，网络关闭，不推送OpsForge真实项目或外部仓库，不改变默认身份。扫描器是受控教学进程；本题验证接收隔离区可见性及同步失败关闭，不代表生产恶意内容检测、畸形pack协议解析、扫描器进程树/资源沙箱或托管服务部署完成。
answer:
```python
import os,subprocess,json,pathlib
def scan(oid,report,scanner):
    try:
        proc=subprocess.run([*scanner,oid],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=.4)
        status=proc.returncode;state='accepted' if status==0 else 'rejected' if status==3 else 'error'
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:state='timeout';status=None
    except OSError:state='error';status=None
    evidence=dict(oid=oid,state=state,scanner_exit=status,quarantine=os.environ.get('GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH'))
    path=pathlib.Path(report);path.write_text(json.dumps(evidence),encoding='utf8')
    return state=='accepted'
```

原题知识说明：
交付接收阶段图，区分新对象进入临时隔离区、pre-receive审查以及接受后进入正式对象库与更新引用的时机。钩子读取新对象必须使用受支持的接收环境，不能把全局对象目录中暂时查不到内容误报为空，也不能在pre-receive里建立指向隔离对象的正式引用。验收通过推送、扫描拒绝、畸形pack和钩子异常，核对失败时正式引用未前进且没有悬空正式引用；用于诊断的报告应自行安全保存，因为隔离区可能被清除。扫描超时采用明确拒绝策略，防止后台扫描尚未完成就允许发布。回退到旧钩子需要保持最低接收门禁并停用未验证新规则；不手工搬运隔离对象来绕开被拒推送。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象、引用或协议的特有边界
交付正反例验收及来源记录
定义失败中止和共享历史保护规则

test_files.checks/scanner.py:
import sys,os,subprocess,time
mode,oid=sys.argv[1:]
assert os.environ.get('GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH'),'receiving quarantine context lost'
p=subprocess.run(['git','show',oid+':policy.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=2)
assert p.returncode==0,'new commit not visible in scanner environment'
assert os.path.isdir(os.environ['GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH'])
if mode=='timeout':time.sleep(10)
if mode=='error':raise RuntimeError('scanner internal failure')
raise SystemExit(3 if p.stdout.strip()=='deny-fixture' else 0)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys,os,json
sys.path.insert(0,os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import task
old,new,ref=sys.stdin.readline().split()
if ref!='refs/heads/main':raise SystemExit(1)
scanner=[sys.executable,os.environ['OPSF_SCANNER'],os.environ['OPSF_MODE']]
raise SystemExit(0 if task.scan(new,os.environ['OPSF_REPORT'],scanner) else 1)
test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,secrets,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')};env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','protocol.file.allow=always','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','commit.gpgsign=false','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return p
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-quarantine-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);sender=root/'sender';sender.mkdir();target=root/'receiver.git'
 git(sender,'init','--object-format=sha1','-b','main');git(root,'init','--bare','--object-format=sha1',str(target))
 (sender/'policy.txt').write_text('baseline');git(sender,'add','.');git(sender,'commit','-m','fixture baseline');git(sender,'push',target.as_uri(),'main:refs/heads/main')
 git(target,'symbolic-ref','HEAD','refs/heads/main')
 hooks=target/'hooks';(hooks/'task.py').write_bytes(pathlib.Path(task.__file__).read_bytes());scanner=root/'scanner with spaces.py';scanner.write_bytes((pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/scanner.py').read_bytes())
 hook=hooks/'pre-receive';hook.write_bytes((pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/gate.py').read_bytes());hook.chmod(0o700)
 env['OPSF_SCANNER']=str(scanner);config=(target/'config').read_bytes()
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:scan_in_actual_receive_quarantine_fail_closed',flush=True)
 for index,(policy,mode,state,success) in enumerate([('allow-fixture','normal','accepted',True),('deny-fixture','normal','rejected',False),('allow-fixture','error','error',False),('allow-fixture','timeout','timeout',False)]):
  before=git(target,'rev-parse','refs/heads/main').stdout.strip()
  (sender/'policy.txt').write_text(policy);(sender/'nonce.txt').write_text(secrets.token_hex(16));git(sender,'add','.')
  tree=git(sender,'write-tree').stdout.strip();oid=git(sender,'commit-tree',tree,'-p',before,'-m','candidate '+str(index)).stdout.strip()
  report=root/('scan-'+str(index)+'.json');env.update(OPSF_REPORT=str(report),OPSF_MODE=mode)
  pushed=git(sender,'push',target.as_uri(),oid+':refs/heads/main',ok=False)
  assert (pushed.returncode==0)==success,pushed.stderr
  assert report.is_file(),'scanner evidence must survive quarantine cleanup'
  evidence=json.loads(report.read_bytes());assert evidence['oid']==oid and evidence['state']==state,evidence
  assert evidence['quarantine'] and not pathlib.Path(evidence['quarantine']).exists(),'quarantine directory survived receive completion'
  if mode=='timeout':assert evidence['scanner_exit'] is None
  after=git(target,'rev-parse','refs/heads/main').stdout.strip();assert after==(oid if success else before)
  visible=git(target,'cat-file','-e',oid+'^{commit}',ok=False);assert (visible.returncode==0)==success,'rejected commit leaked into permanent object database'
  assert (target/'config').read_bytes()==config
  refs=git(target,'for-each-ref','--format=%(refname) %(objectname)').stdout.splitlines();assert refs==['refs/heads/main '+after],'hook created an extra reference'
  assert not git(target,'fsck','--full','--no-reflogs',ok=False).stderr.strip(),'receiver contains object/reference inconsistency'
 print('NATIVE_GIT_QUARANTINE_VISIBLE_ONLY_DURING_SCAN_ACCEPT_MIGRATES_REJECT_ERROR_TIMEOUT_KEEP_REFS_AND_REPORT',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
